goal: Add input validation and error handling to the user API

contracts.name: error response
contracts.meaning: JSON {error, code}, status 400 for invalid input

tasks.title: Validation schemas
tasks.prompt: Create src/validation/user.ts with schemas for create and update user payloads. Add unit tests in test/validation.test.ts. Done when both payload shapes are validated and tests cover valid and invalid input.

tasks.title: Error middleware
tasks.prompt: Add src/middleware/errors.ts that maps thrown errors to JSON responses {error, code}. Add tests. Do not touch route files.

tasks.title: Wire validation into routes
tasks.prompt: Use the schemas from src/validation/user.ts in src/routes/users.ts and register the error middleware from src/middleware/errors.ts. Return 400 on invalid input. Add route tests.
